title: Reddit CEO says chatbots are not a traffic driver
description: During Reddit's Q3 2025 call, CEO Steve Huffman noted that Google search and direct access continue to be its top traffic drivers.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Nvidia expands AI ties with Hyundai, Samsung, SK, Naver
description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is visiting South Korea to strengthen partnerships with Samsung, Hyundai, SK, and Naver, unveiling plans for AI-powered networks and next-generation intelligent systems.
author: Kate Park
